drafts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE original cyberpunk inventory item sprite, an L-shaped heavy elbow actuator. Transparent background, no scene, text, logo or UI. Orthographic top view, no diagonal perspective, photorealistic hand-painted game prop with broad readable shapes, worn ochre-orange painted metal, graphite joints, brushed steel bolts and a tiny cyan indicator. IMPORTANT precise packing silhouette: overall 2 units wide by 3 units high, occupying exactly the left cell in each of three rows plus the bottom-right cell: rows [X. / X. / XX]. The tall left column is a thick industrial linear piston housing; the bottom horizontal foot is a broad right-angle motor head. Entire object forms one continuous chunky L, nearly full unit thickness throughout, square ends with subtly rounded corners. The top-right TWO cells remain completely transparent, an open rectangular concavity, with NO cable, shadow, glow or support across it. The body has shallow bevels and rich machine details entirely inside this L silhouette. Fill the occupied cells almost edge-to-edge, less than 3 percent padding around the overall object. Neutral warm top-left workshop illumination and restrained cool rim highlights. Do not draw a grid or individual tiles. This is a convincing single salvaged future machine component shaped to fit an L inventory footprint, not colored puzzle blocks.

Use case: stylized-concept. ONE original cyberpunk inventory item sprite on a fully transparent background. A chunky T-shaped power junction transformer, orthographic top view with no diagonal camera tilt. Exact packing silhouette: 3 equal square units wide and 2 high, rows [XXX / .X.]. A wide horizontal crossbar housing fills the entire top row with three connected copper induction coils in worn blue-black metal; a broad solid central output connector projects straight downward into the center cell of the lower row. Lower-left and lower-right cells must stay fully transparent with no cables, shadow, glow or casing. One continuous industrial T silhouette, large thick components almost filling their occupied squares, square ends and small rounded bevels. Photorealistic painterly game prop, blue graphite alloy, copper coil details, weathered brass fasteners, two tiny cyan indicator lamps. Warm overhead workshop light, faint cyan edge highlights, clear readable outline at small inventory sizes. Fill overall object bounds with less than 3 percent surrounding padding. No text, branding, symbols, UI, grid, floor, extraneous objects or puzzle tiles.

Use case: stylized-concept. ONE original cyberpunk inventory item sprite, a Z-shaped offset memory array, on a genuinely transparent background. Orthographic top view, no perspective skew. Exact inventory shape: overall 3 square units wide and 2 square units high, occupied cells [XX. / .XX]. Four broad blackened-teal memory banks are welded into one continuous staggered rigid circuit housing: upper row spans left and center, lower row spans center and right. Upper-right and lower-left corners are entirely transparent empty square cutouts. No wires, shadows or glow may bridge those empty cells. Make a robust solid Z outline with almost square-ended thick banks, filling the four occupied cells almost edge to edge. Photorealistic painterly salvaged high-tech electronics, deep graphite case, oxidized teal plates, gold data contacts, small violet status light, visible screws and restrained scuffs, rich coherent material details. Warm workshop key light and fine cool edge accents; silhouette must read at tiny scale. Less than 3 percent padding around overall object bounds. No text, logo, environment, UI, checkerboard, grid lines or separate puzzle blocks.

replacements.name: 充电电钻
replacements.prompt: Create ONE inventory illustration of an immediately recognizable cordless electric drill for a cyberpunk secondhand shop. A real believable hand-held power tool, with a stout brushed steel chuck and short drill bit pointing LEFT at the TOP, a substantial curved pistol grip descending down the RIGHT, a visible orange trigger, and a rectangular removable battery at the bottom of the grip. Overall portrait 2:3 proportions. The natural silhouette leaves an open space below the barrel at the lower LEFT. Do not turn it into a letter, puzzle piece, modular block, or stretched machine box. Keep correct tool anatomy and realistic proportions. Three-quarter view very close to a side view, whole object visible, strong simple recognizable silhouette; make chuck, drill bit, trigger and grip readable at small size. Distinctive scuffed safety-yellow body with dark rubber grip, brushed steel hardware, small cyan battery-charge indicator, traces of workshop dust. Painterly photorealistic game prop, restrained cyan ambient rim and warm neutral light. Genuine transparent background, no floor or cast shadow, no surrounding glow, no text, labels, logo, numbers, UI or border. Use the image bounds generously while preserving natural proportions.

replacements.name: 三通阀
replacements.prompt: Create ONE inventory illustration of a clearly recognizable three-way industrial pipe valve for a cyberpunk secondhand shop. The first read must be plumbing hardware: a thick oxidized brass horizontal pipe with large circular threaded sockets facing LEFT and RIGHT, a third threaded outlet pointing straight DOWN at center, and a distinctive RED spoked handwheel at the junction. A physically believable one-piece T-junction valve, not electronic blocks or a puzzle tile. Wide 3:2 overall proportions, almost front/top view with shallow perspective, both lower corners naturally empty. Keep round pipe bores, handwheel spokes and hexagonal unions large and legible at small inventory size. Worn bronze/brass, green oxidation, dull steel threaded collars, red painted wheel with chipped edges, no glowing screens. Photorealistic painterly game prop, warm overhead workshop lighting, a faint cool metal reflection. The entire valve in frame, generous close crop, natural proportions. Genuinely transparent background, no floor, cast shadow, fog or glow in the empty corners. No text, logo, UI, grid, border, extra parts or puzzle blocks.

replacements.name: 折叠检修灯
replacements.prompt: Create ONE inventory illustration of an unmistakable portable folding work light for a cyberpunk repair shop. A wide horizontal LED lamp head in the UPPER LEFT shows a large bright frosted-white rectangular diffuser with a visible row of small emitters; a short central articulated hinge support connects it to a broad rechargeable battery base in the LOWER RIGHT. The lamp head and base overlap around the middle, forming a natural staggered silhouette, with upper-right and lower-left corners empty. Wide 3:2 composition, shallow nearly orthographic FRONT view so the glowing light panel, hinge and battery base are instantly recognizable. Do not build the light out of colored puzzle squares or generic armored blocks. Correct mechanical proportions: clearly thin lamp-head housing, readable hinge joint and sturdy base with a carry loop and one physical round switch. Pale ivory and olive-green painted body, charcoal rubber edges, brushed metal hinge, light wear, a tiny amber charging lamp. Photorealistic painterly prop, warm neutral workshop illumination, restrained cool highlights; the diffuser glows within its panel only. Full object close framed, no stretching. Genuinely transparent background, no floor, cast shadow, atmospheric bloom, typography, numbers, logo, grid or UI.
